# MCP tools: Ready conversations

<!-- Generated by `sidekick.mcp.export_tool_reference` from `contracts/mcp-tools.generated.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

[MCP tool reference](index.md) | 4 model-visible tools. The tools of this area that only the MCP App rooms call are on the [app-only page](app-only.md).

A ready conversation is the owner's standing prompt for Claude on a schedule. Starting one composes its summary from the owner's records at that moment and stores nothing of it.

## `list_ready_conversations`

List the owner's ready conversations (active and paused unless state is given): title, kind, instruction (unverified text unless instruction_verified), ingredients, cadence, today's state and whether each is ready now.

Access: read

Scopes: requires `start:read`.

Returns: `ReadyConversationPageOutput` with `items` (array of ReadyConversationRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | string | no | one of `active`, `paused`, `archived`; may be null |

## `save_ready_conversation`

Draft a ready conversation (leave out conversation_id; needs title and cadence) or change one at expected_version; pause, resume, archive or restore it with paused and archived.

Access: write

Scopes: requires `start:read`, `start:write`.

Returns: `SavedReadyConversationOutput` with `conversation` (ReadyConversationRecord), `ignored_nulls` (array of string).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `changes` | object | yes | Fields to change: omitted or null stays; to empty the instruction, list it in clear. |
| `changes.archived` | boolean | no | may be null; True archives it, false restores it. |
| `changes.cadence` | object | no | may be null; The days it is ready and the local time it becomes so. |
| `changes.cadence.frequency` | string | yes | - |
| `changes.cadence.local_time` | string | yes | - |
| `changes.cadence.day_of_month` | integer | no | may be null |
| `changes.cadence.interval` | integer | no | default `1` |
| `changes.cadence.last_weekday` | boolean | no | default `false` |
| `changes.cadence.until` | date | no | ISO 8601 date; may be null |
| `changes.cadence.weekdays` | array of integer | no | default `[]` |
| `changes.ingredients` | array of string | no | items: `tasks_done_today`, `tasks_due_today`, `tasks_due_tomorrow`, `overdue`, `waiting`, `suggestions`, `journal_today`, `review`, `automation_report`, `shopping_open`; may be null; What a start reads; send an empty list for none. |
| `changes.instruction` | string | no | 1 to 2000 characters; may be null; The owner's own words for Claude when the conversation starts. |
| `changes.kind` | string | no | one of `evening_review`, `morning_plan`, `weekly_review`, `custom`; may be null |
| `changes.paused` | boolean | no | may be null |
| `changes.title` | string | no | 1 to 80 characters; may be null |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `clear` | array of "instruction" | no | unique; may be null |
| `conversation_id` | uuid | no | may be null |
| `expected_version` | integer | no | at least 1; may be null |

A nested field is listed under its parent as `parent.field`; `parent[].field` is a field of each item in the list. Required means required inside its parent.

## `start_ready_conversation`

Start a ready conversation today: marks the day started and returns its instruction, who wrote it, and a summary of the ingredients you may read (counts and short lines, composed now, not stored).

Access: write

Scopes: requires `start:read`, `start:write`; some arguments or parts of the answer also use `automation:read`, `journal:read`, `shopping:read`, `tasks:read`.

Returns: `StartedReadyConversationOutput` with `blocks` (array of ReadyBlockRecord), `conversation` (ReadyConversationRecord), `instruction_notice` (string or null), `truncated` (boolean), `unavailable` (array of string or null).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `conversation_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |

## `skip_ready_conversation`

Skip a ready conversation on a day (today when day is left out), or undo that skip with undo.

Access: write

Scopes: requires `start:read`, `start:write`.

Returns: `ReadyConversationOutput` with `conversation` (ReadyConversationRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `conversation_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `day` | date | no | ISO 8601 date; may be null |
| `undo` | boolean | no | default `false` |
